group.label: Quickshipper
group.comment: Courier delivery through Quickshipper (Wolt, Glovo, OnWay and other Georgian couriers). You need a Quickshipper merchant account with API access. Recommended: in the Quickshipper dashboard, let orders assign the courier automatically. With "after confirmation" the module confirms each booking itself when you submit the shipment.

field.label: Title
field.comment: Shown at checkout above the courier options, e.g. "Quickshipper" or "Courier delivery". Can be set per store view, e.g. in Georgian for a Georgian store view.

field.label: Sandbox Mode
field.comment: Yes: use Quickshipper's test environment (no real couriers). Log in with a test account created at test.quickshipper.ge. No: use the live environment and your real account.

field.label: Login Email
field.comment: The email you use to log in to the Quickshipper dashboard (test or live account, matching Sandbox Mode).

field.label: Password
field.comment: Your Quickshipper dashboard password. Stored encrypted.

field.label: API Client ID
field.comment: API client credentials for the live environment, issued by Quickshipper when API access is enabled for your account. Ask Quickshipper support if you do not have them.

field.label: API Client Secret
field.comment: Issued by Quickshipper together with the Client ID. Stored encrypted.

field.label: API Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: How long to wait for Quickshipper before giving up. Quickshipper usually answers within a second or two, but its first answer after a quiet period can take more than 10 seconds; with a shorter limit, checkout then shows no Quickshipper option. Customers wait at most this long at checkout. Default: 20.

field.label: Debug Logging
field.comment: Log full Quickshipper API requests and responses (passwords and keys masked) to var/log/shubo_qshpr.log. A one-line summary of every call and all errors are always logged there, regardless of this setting.

field.label: Show Balance in Admin Header
field.comment: Yes: the balance of your prepaid Quickshipper account is shown at the top of every admin page to admins who may create shipments, so you can top it up before a booking is refused. It is read from Quickshipper at most every 5 minutes. The account shown is the one saved for the default store view.

field.label: Pickup Latitude
field.comment: Where couriers collect parcels, as map coordinates — e.g. 41.7151 for Tbilisi. In Google Maps, right-click the spot and click the numbers to copy them: the first is the latitude, the second the longitude. The pickup address text is taken from Stores → Configuration → Sales → Shipping Settings → Origin, the name and phone the courier uses from General → Store Information. Quickshipper is not offered at checkout until both coordinates, the Origin street and city, and the store name and phone are set.

field.label: Pickup Longitude
field.comment: The second number of the pickup point's coordinates — e.g. 44.8271 for Tbilisi.

field.label: Book Courier Automatically
field.comment: Yes: once an order is fully paid, the courier the customer chose is booked and the order is shipped within a minute or two, without pressing Ship. Orders without a paid invoice (e.g. cash on delivery) still wait for Ship. If booking fails, it is tried up to three times and then you are notified in the admin. No: book with Ship → Submit Shipment.

field.label: Cancel Delivery on Full Refund
field.comment: Yes: when an order is refunded in full, its Quickshipper delivery is cancelled if no courier has taken it yet (Quickshipper returns the delivery price and may keep its service fee); otherwise you are notified. No: cancel deliveries yourself with the button on the shipment page.

field.label: Delivery Status Updates
field.comment: Registers this store's address at Quickshipper, so each delivery status (courier assigned, on the way, delivered) reaches the order within seconds. Without it, statuses are checked every 15 minutes. Save the login first; the store must be reachable from the internet.

field.label: Show Courier Logos at Checkout
field.comment: Yes: each courier's logo (Wolt, Glovo, …), as Quickshipper provides it, is shown beside its delivery option at checkout, so customers see which company delivers. The images are loaded from Quickshipper's servers.

field.label: Customer Pays Quickshipper's Service Fee
field.comment: Yes: the price at checkout is Quickshipper's full price, which already includes Quickshipper's service fee per order. No: the service fee is taken off the price the customer sees, and your shop pays it. Either way Quickshipper takes the full price from your balance.

field.label: Car Delivery Attribute
field.comment: A Yes/No product attribute of your store, e.g. "Bulky item". When a product in the cart has it set to Yes, Quickshipper is asked for a courier with a car. Choose "-- Not used --" to decide by weight and the default below only.

field.label: Car Delivery by Default
field.comment: Yes: every Quickshipper delivery asks for a courier with a car. No: a car is asked for only when a product in the cart has the Car Delivery Attribute set to Yes, or the parcel reaches Car Delivery from Weight. Only couriers with cars are then offered.

field.label: Car Delivery from Weight (kg)
field.comment: Optional. From this parcel weight on, a courier with a car is always asked for. Couriers on foot or by bike may refuse a heavy parcel or charge more once they see it. Leave empty to decide by the products only.

group.label: Opening Hours
group.comment: The hours your shop hands parcels to couriers, every day, in store time. Delivery time slots are offered only within them. Quickshipper does not publish the couriers' working hours; keep these within them.

field.label: Book Couriers Only While Open
field.comment: Yes: outside these hours, checkout tells the customer the courier is booked after opening (e.g. "after we open, Tue 10:00"), the delivery time list does not offer "As soon as possible", and automatic booking of an as-soon-as-possible order waits until opening. No: couriers are offered the same at any hour.

field.label: Opens at (hour)
field.comment: Store time, 1–23. Default: 10.

field.label: Closes at (hour)
field.comment: Store time, 2–24. Default: 20.

group.label: Delivery Time
group.comment: Lets the customer choose a later delivery time instead of "as soon as possible". Offered for the couriers that Quickshipper says take a delivery time. The courier is booked for that time when the shipment is submitted. Quickshipper does not publish how far ahead or at which hours each courier accepts a time; slots are offered within the shop's opening hours (set above), so keep those within your couriers' working hours.

field.label: Let Customers Choose a Delivery Time
field.comment: Yes: for a courier that Quickshipper says takes a delivery time, checkout shows a "Delivery time" list with "As soon as possible" and the slots set below, within the opening hours. No: every delivery is as soon as possible. In the Quickshipper dashboard, let orders assign the courier automatically: with "after confirmation", Quickshipper was seen to replace the chosen time with "now" when the booking is confirmed (you are told in the order's history).

field.label: Days Ahead
field.comment: How many days after today can be chosen. Default: 2.

field.label: Minimum Notice (hours)
field.comment: A slot must start at least this long after the order is placed, so there is time to prepare the parcel. Default: 2.

group.label: Address Geocoding
group.comment: Quickshipper prices a delivery by map coordinates, so the customer's address is first turned into a point on the map by a geocoding service. Only addresses found to the exact building are offered Quickshipper delivery.

field.label: Geocoder
field.comment: The service that finds the address on the map.

field.label: Nominatim Server URL
field.comment: Default: OpenStreetMap's free public server, https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org. It allows at most one request per second and no heavy use, so it suits testing and small shops. A busy shop should run its own Nominatim server and enter its address here. Customer addresses are sent to this server.

field.label: Clean Up Addresses Before Lookup
field.comment: Rewrites only the text sent to the geocoder (never the order's address): drops postcodes, "№" and a leading "ქ. თბილისი,", and turns registry-style street names into the way people write them. On 228 Georgian addresses it raised Nominatim's hits from 42% to 81%. Turn it off if your geocoder finds fewer addresses with it (another geocoder, or addresses outside Georgia).
